quote: USTDA awarded funding for technical assistance to the Central American Corporation for Air Navigation Services (COCESNA)... to develop a comprehensive roadmap to enhance the safety, security, and resiliency of critical air navigation systems across Belize, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, and Honduras. COCESNA has selected Cibernetika, LLC, to provide the technical assistance.
note: Opened USTDA 27 Aug 2026 English release; TA amount blank on page.
